criteria_verification.notes: Independent tests confirm WebM Duration element parsing calculates correct seconds and streamed WebM (no Duration) returns None. Tests cover standard duration, custom timescale, 8-byte encoding, zero duration, and missing timescale defaults.

Independent tests confirm Ogg/Opus EOS granule calculates duration as granule/48000, header-page granule 0 returns None, and false-sync OggS bytes are properly skipped. Tests cover invalid version, non-EOS pages, negative granules, and truncated data.

Independent tests confirm unknown/absent content types and truncated/garbage bytes return None without raising exceptions. 11+ malformed input tests cover truncated WebM/Ogg, garbage bytes, empty content, malformed EBML headers, and missing segments.

Independent tests confirm builders (make_webm, make_ogg_opus) produce bytes that probe_duration_seconds() successfully parses. Round-trip tests verify multiple durations (0.5s to 10.5s) parse correctly for both WebM and Ogg formats.
All quality gates passed. 35 tests run successfully with zero linting errors. Evidence shows clean ruff compliance for both implementation and test files.

rationale: All 5 acceptance criteria independently verified by Coach's pytest run (35 tests passed, 92% coverage). Implementation demonstrates robust WebM EBML parsing and Ogg/Opus granule calculation with exceptional edge case coverage. Minor reporting issue (incorrectly claimed .cov_output/coverage.json) noted but doesn't affect implementation quality. Code is production-ready.
